label: dam-probe-p13-aiself
_why: ENGINE PROBE: does the engine's own AI build dams once they carry ownership_type = self? (user, 2026-09-27: 'For the test, remove scripted queue adds. I suspect that the reason AI never built the dams without them is the same declaration that we just removed.') Every earlier probe (p6-p12) and century run had dams WITHOUT an ownership_type, which the engine treats like an administration (refused in a foreign state, CANNOT_EXPAND_BUILDING_NOT_OWNABLE, found in the user's playtest), and the AI never queued a dam itself (F169). Arm = config/mod_config.canon-dams-aiself-probe.json {kind: config}: the probe book (dam technologies granted to ten majors, 2-month surveys, level cost x0.05, USA/FRA on laissez-faire) with dams.ai.driver_build = false and driver_finance = false - the quarterly driver only SURVEYS; no start_building_construction, no financed level. Any dam level that appears was queued by the engine's AI.

_questions.Q1: Does any AI country queue a dam level in its OWN state (a building_dam_* with levels > 0 in its save summary, or in its government construction queue)?
_questions.Q2: Does any AI overlord queue a dam level in a SUBJECT's state through its own government queue (a level owned by a foreign country in the host's ownership split)?
_questions.Q3: Does anything land in a PRIVATE queue, or end up owned by a financial district / company (can_build_private stays always = no)?

_predictions.Q1: yes, in at least two of the ten granted majors within three years (ai_value 30,000 and must_have subsidies, at x0.05 cost) - stated with low confidence: F169's null may also have another cause
_predictions.Q2: rarer than Q1 if at all - the government AI's foreign construction is a separate, sparser path

_read: save summaries: building_dam_* levels and ownership_levels by owner class per country, yearly; queue_rungs / queue_mix style read of the government and private queues; PMR_DAM survey_* and built lines in debug.log (no stage_start or finance_* lines can appear - the driver emits none).
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: techs granted, costs and surveys shrunk - do not read any economic number from it.
A null here is NOT conclusive for the canon: at canon costs (x20 dearer) and real technology dates the AI's weighing differs - the century arm canon_dams_aiself_n1 answers that.
